2609.11770.title: The widening evaluation gap in medical large language model research 2023 to 2026
2609.11770.paper_summary: Large language models are superseded every few quarters; clinical evidence takes years. We asked whether medical research is keeping pace with the systems it evaluates. PubMed returned 11,628 records for January 2023 to June 2026 across fourteen clinical domains, growing 45-fold; 2.5% used a randomised, controlled or prospective design. Evaluation lag, from a study's newest named model release to its own publication, widened from 1.33 to 6.08 quarters. Because discontinued models age mechanically, we benchmarked this against a counterfactual holding model composition fixed: migration to newer systems offset only 56% of the drift (95% CI 50-65). Randomised trials evaluated models a median 4.6 quarters older than other designs (P = 3 x 10^-19), yet among studies naming a model still under development no design differed from any other; 62% of randomised trials evaluated a discontinued family. Rigour and currency are in tension, and that tension reflects model selection rather than research timelines.
2609.11770.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型每隔幾個季度就會被取代；臨床證據需要數年。我們詢問醫學研究是否跟上了其評估的系統。PubMed 在 2023 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月之間返回了 11,628 條記錄，涵蓋十四個臨床領域，增長了 45 倍；其中 2.5% 使用了隨機、對照或前瞻性設計。從研究最新命名模型發布到其自身出版的評估延遲，從 1.33 擴大到 6.08 個季度。由於停用的模型機械性老化，我們將其與一個反事實進行基準比較，固定模型組成：向新系統的遷移僅抵消了 56% 的漂移（95% CI 50-65）。隨機試驗評估的模型中位數比其他設計大 4.6 個季度（P = 3 x 10^-19），然而在命名仍在開發中的模型的研究中，沒有設計與其他任何設計不同；62% 的隨機試驗評估了一個已停用的系列。嚴謹性和時效性之間存在緊張關係，而這種緊張反映的是模型選擇而非研究時間表。
